name: Foresight Dolly
original_name: フォーサイト・ドリィ
source:
Dolly is an android who escaped from the factory under mysterious circumstances. She was captured by its creators, but eventually managed to flee with the help of the science technician Amy. The two girls suddenly find themselves teleported to a fantasy world, and must find a way to return home.

Foresight Dolly is a role-playing game that can be described as "light". The player controls Dolly who travels through interconnected areas, most of which consisting of dungeon-like passages. Dolly can equip a weapon and one item as armor. Enemies are visible on screen, and contact with them triggers a turn-based battle, where Dolly can attack physically or use special techniques. Experience and money are gained from combat. The game also has a day and night cycle; Dolly and Amy would automatically go to sleep late in the evening, restoring Dolly's hit points.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/61633/foresight-dolly/]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
多莉是一个在离奇情形下逃出工厂的仿生人。制造者曾将她抓回，最后她又在技术员艾米的帮助下逃了出来。两个女孩突然被传送到一个奇幻世界，必须设法找出回家的路。

《Foresight Dolly》是一款轻量级角色扮演游戏。玩家操纵多莉穿行于相互连通的区域，大多是迷宫般的通道。她能装备一件武器，并选一件物品充当防具。敌人直接出现在画面里，接触后便进入回合制战斗，多莉可以发动普通攻击或施展特殊招式。战斗能赚得经验与金钱。游戏还有昼夜变化，到了深夜，多莉与艾米会自动入睡，恢复多莉的生命值。

［摘自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/61633/foresight-dolly/]MobyGames[/url]］
